    12→
    13→// ShowcaseConfig controls showcase-specific redaction for public sharing.
    14→// This applies additional privacy-focused redaction beyond standard entropy detection.
    15→type ShowcaseConfig struct {
    16→	RedactPaths       bool     // Normalize file paths (e.g., /Users/x/project/src → src/)
    17→	RedactUsernames   bool     // Replace usernames/emails
    18→	RedactProjectInfo bool     // Replace repo/project names from git remotes
    19→	AllowedPaths      []string // Paths to preserve (e.g., "src/", "lib/")
    20→	AllowedDomains    []string // Domains to keep (e.g., "@example.com")
    21→	CustomBlocklist   []string // Additional terms to redact (glob patterns)
    22→}
    23→
    24→// DefaultShowcaseConfig returns sensible defaults for showcase redaction.
    25→func DefaultShowcaseConfig() ShowcaseConfig {
    26→	return ShowcaseConfig{
    27→		RedactPaths:       true,
    28→		RedactUsernames:   true,
    29→		RedactProjectInfo: true,
    30→		AllowedPaths:      []string{"src/", "lib/", "cmd/", "pkg/", "internal/"},
    31→		AllowedDomains:    []string{},
    32→		CustomBlocklist:   []string{},
    33→	}
    34→}
    35→
    36→// Showcase applies showcase redaction after standard entropy-based redaction.
    37→// Call String() or JSONLBytes() first, then apply Showcase() for layered protection.
    38→func Showcase(s string, cfg ShowcaseConfig) string {
    39→	result := s
    40→
    41→	// Layer 1: Pattern-based redaction
    42→	result = redactPatterns(result)
    43→
    44→	// Layer 2: Blocklist matching
    45→	result = redactBlocklist(result, cfg.CustomBlocklist)
    46→
    47→	// Layer 3: Structural normalization
    48→	if cfg.RedactPaths {
    49→		result = redactFilePaths(result, cfg.AllowedPaths)
    50→	}
    51→	if cfg.RedactUsernames {
    52→		result = redactUsernames(result, cfg.AllowedDomains)
    53→	}
    54→	if cfg.RedactProjectInfo {
    55→		result = redactProjectInfo(result)
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	return result
    59→}
    60→
    61→// ShowcaseJSONL applies showcase redaction to JSONL session data.
    62→// Preserves JSON structure while redacting values.
    63→func ShowcaseJSONL(b []byte, cfg ShowcaseConfig) ([]byte, error) {
    64→	var buf bytes.Buffer
    65→	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(b))
    66→
    67→	// Increase buffer size for large lines (up to 10MB per line)
    68→	maxCapacity := 10 * 1024 * 1024
    69→	scanBuf := make([]byte, maxCapacity)
    70→	scanner.Buffer(scanBuf, maxCapacity)
    71→
    72→	for scanner.Scan() {
    73→		line := scanner.Bytes()
    74→		if len(line) == 0 {
    75→			continue
    76→		}
    77→
    78→		// Parse JSON to preserve structure
    79→		var entry map[string]any
    80→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &entry); err != nil {
    81→			// Fallback: treat as plain string
    82→			redacted := Showcase(string(line), cfg)
    83→			buf.WriteString(redacted)
    84→			buf.WriteByte('\n')
    85→			continue
    86→		}
    87→
    88→		// Recursively redact values (but not keys)
    89→		redactJSONValues(entry, cfg)
    90→
    91→		// Re-serialize
    92→		redactedLine, err := json.Marshal(entry)
    93→		if err != nil {
    94→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal redacted JSON: %w", err)
    95→		}
    96→
    97→		buf.Write(redactedLine)
    98→		buf.WriteByte('\n')
    99→	}
   100→
   101→	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
   102→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan JSONL: %w", err)
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	return buf.Bytes(), nil
   106→}
   107→
   108→// redactJSONValues recursively redacts values in JSON objects/arrays while preserving keys.
   109→func redactJSONValues(v any, cfg ShowcaseConfig) {
   110→	switch val := v.(type) {
   111→	case map[string]any:
   112→		for key, child := range val {
   113→			switch childVal := child.(type) {
   114→			case string:
   115→				// Redact string values (but not keys)
   116→				val[key] = Showcase(childVal, cfg)
   117→			case map[string]any, []any:
   118→				// Recurse into nested structures
   119→				redactJSONValues(childVal, cfg)
   120→			}
   121→		}
   122→	case []any:
   123→		for i, child := range val {
   124→			switch childVal := child.(type) {
   125→			case string:
   126→				val[i] = Showcase(childVal, cfg)
   127→			case map[string]any, []any:
   128→				redactJSONValues(childVal, cfg)
   129→			}
   130→		}
   131→	}
   132→}
   133→
   134→// Pattern-based redaction
   135→
   136→var (
   137→	// Internal URLs and private IPs
   138→	internalURLPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b[a-z0-9-]+\.(internal|local|corp|lan)\b(:[0-9]+)?`)
   139→	privateIPPattern   = regexp.MustCompile(`\b(?:10\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3})(?::[0-9]+)?\b`)
   140→
   141→	// Cloud ARNs
   142→	awsARNPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`arn:aws:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z0-9/._-]+`)
   143→	gcpPattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`projects/[a-z0-9-]+/[a-zA-Z0-9/._-]+`)
   144→
   145→	// Database connection strings
   146→	dbConnPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(postgres|postgresql|mongodb|mysql|redis)://[^\s\)\"\']+`)
   147→
   148→	// Email addresses (basic pattern)
   149→	emailPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`)
   150→
   151→	// AWS account IDs (12 digits in AWS context)
   152→	awsAccountPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(aws|account|arn)[\s:][^\s]*?([0-9]{12})\b`)
   153→
   154→	// JWT tokens (starts with eyJ)
   155→	jwtPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\b`)

    17→//

    23→//
    24→// Returns nil, error if transcript is empty or cannot be parsed.
    25→func GenerateFromTranscript(ctx context.Context, transcriptBytes []byte, filesTouched []string, generator Generator) (*checkpoint.Summary, error) {
    26→	if len(transcriptBytes) == 0 {
    27→		return nil, errors.New("empty transcript")
    28→	}
    29→
    30→	// Build condensed transcript for summarization
    31→	condensed, err := BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptBytes)
    32→	if err != nil {

    52→	}

   122→func BuildCondensedTranscript(lines []transcript.Line) []Entry {
   123→	var entries []Entry

## Comprehensive Exploration Report: Explain Command Structure

I've thoroughly analyzed the `explain` command implementation across `explain.go` and `explain_formatters.go`. Here's a detailed breakdown of the patterns you can reuse for building the insights command:

---

### 1. **Flag Handling Pattern**

The explain command uses a well-structured flag validation pattern:

```
Flag Groups:
├── Core filters
│   ├── --session (string)      - Filter checkpoints by session ID
│   ├── --commit (string)       - Explain specific commit
│   └── --checkpoint/-c (string) - Explain specific checkpoint
│
├── Verbosity levels
│   ├── --short/-s (bool)       - Summary only
│   ├── --full (bool)           - Full parsed transcript
│   ├── --raw-transcript (bool) - Raw JSONL
│   └── --no-pager (bool)       - Disable pager output
│
├── Summary generation
│   ├── --generate (bool)       - Generate AI summary
│   └── --force (bool)          - Regenerate if exists
│
└── Export functionality
    ├── --export (bool)         - Enable structured export
    ├── --showcase (bool)       - Apply privacy redaction
    ├── --format (string)       - json|markdown (default: json)
    └── --output/-o (string)    - File path for export
```

**Key validation patterns:**
- Lines 152-177: Flag dependencies validated at the start of `RunE`
- Mutually exclusive flag groups defined at lines 202-207
- Custom validation via `MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive()`
- Early return on validation errors before any I/O operations

**Reusable code** (lines 146-182):
```go
// Check if Entire is disabled (guards all commands)
if checkDisabledGuard(cmd.OutOrStdout()) {
    return nil
}

// Validate flag dependencies
if generateFlag && checkpointFlag == "" {
    return errors.New("--generate requires --checkpoint/-c flag")
}

// Convert short flag to verbose (verbose = !short)
verbose := !shortFlag
```

---

### 2. **Session Data Loading & Access Pattern**

The explain command loads checkpoint data through a clean abstraction:

**Two-level checkpoint system:**
- **Committed checkpoints** (persistent, permanent)
  - Stored on `entire/checkpoints/v1` orphan branch
  - Accessed via `store.ListCommitted()` → `store.ReadCommitted()` → `store.ReadLatestSessionContent()`
- **Temporary checkpoints** (session-specific, shadow branches)
  - Stored on shadow branches: `entire/<commit-hash[:7]>-<worktreeHash[:6]>`
  - Accessed via `store.ListTemporary()` → `store.ListCheckpointsForBranch()`

**Loading pattern** (lines 251-315):

```go
repo, err := openRepository()                          // Line 252
store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)                  // Line 257

// Try committed checkpoints first
committed, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())  // Line 260

// Match by prefix to handle partial IDs
var matches []id.CheckpointID
for _, info := range committed {
    if strings.HasPrefix(info.CheckpointID.String(), checkpointIDPrefix) {
        matches = append(matches, info.CheckpointID)
    }
}

// Load full checkpoint summary
summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)  // Line 302

// Load latest session content
content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)  // Line 311
```

**Key abstractions to reuse:**
- `checkpoint.GitStore` - Central store interface (lines 257, 1009)
- `checkpoint.CheckpointSummary` - Root metadata with aggregated stats
- `checkpoint.SessionContent` - Full session data (transcript, prompts, metadata)
- `checkpoint.CommittedMetadata` - Per-session metadata with token usage, summary, etc.
- `id.CheckpointID` - Type-safe checkpoint identifier (12-hex-char)

**Fallback to temporary checkpoints** (lines 276-289):
When committed checkpoint not found, try temporary checkpoints with `explainTemporaryCheckpoint()` which:
- Lists all shadow branches
- Filters by commit hash prefix
- Handles ambiguous prefixes
- Falls back gracefully

---

### 3. **Formatter Organization**

Formatters are organized by **output destination** and **format type**:

**In `explain_formatters.go`:**

| Function | Purpose | Output |
|----------|---------|--------|
| `formatExportJSON()` | Structured export | JSON object with checkpoint data |
| `formatExportMarkdown()` | Human-friendly export | Markdown document with sections |

**Shared formatting utilities** (from `explain.go`):

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `formatCheckpointOutput()` | Main display formatter (verbose/full/short modes) |
| `formatTranscriptBytes()` | Parse & format JSONL transcript |
| `formatSummaryDetails()` | AI summary sections (learnings, friction, open items) |
| `formatBranchCheckpoints()` | List view with checkpoint grouping |
| `formatCheckpointGroup()` | Single checkpoint group formatting |

**Key formatter characteristics:**

1. **Modular design** - Each formatter handles one output format
2. **Reuses transcript parsing** - `formatTranscriptBytes()` calls `summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes()` 
3. **Handles missing data gracefully** - Fallback strings when transcript unavailable
4. **Privacy-aware** - Export formatters apply redaction before output (lines 408-439)

**Code reuse example** (lines 84-87 of explain_formatters.go):
```go
sb.WriteString("## Transcript\n\n")
formattedTranscript := formatTranscriptBytes(transcript, "")  // Shared function!
sb.WriteString(formattedTranscript)
```

---

### 4. **Strategy Package Integration**

The explain command is **strategy-agnostic** but uses strategy helpers:

**Key integration points:**

1. **Checkpoint discovery** (lines 1008-1130 in `getBranchCheckpoints()`):
   ```go
   // Strategy-agnostic: queries both committed & temporary
   committedInfos, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   tempPoints := getReachableTemporaryCheckpoints(repo, store, head.Hash(), isOnDefault, limit)
   ```

2. **Session info** from `strategy.RewindPoint`:
   ```go
   type RewindPoint struct {
       ID               string                    // Commit hash or branch name
       Message          string                    // Human-readable description
       Date             time.Time
       IsLogsOnly       bool                      // Committed vs temporary
       CheckpointID     id.CheckpointID           // Stable 12-hex ID
       SessionID        string
       SessionPrompt    string                    // First line of prompt
       IsTaskCheckpoint bool
       ToolUseID        string
       Agent            agent.AgentType
   }
   ```

3. **Helper functions** used:
   ```go
   strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(tree, metadataDir)     // Line 544
   strategy.TruncateDescription(text, maxLen)               // Line 559
   strategy.IsOnDefaultBranch(repo)                         // Line 935
   strategy.GetDefaultBranchName(repo)                      // Line 942
   strategy.GetMainBranchHash(repo)                         // Line 952
   strategy.GetCurrentBranchName(repo)                      // Line 1236
   ```

4. **Transcript utilities** from `summarize` package:
   ```go
   summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptBytes)   // Line 682
   summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(ctx, scopedTranscript, files) // Line 381
   ```

---

### 5. **Session & Checkpoint Access Helpers**

**Session content retrieval** (not strategy-specific):

```go
// Load any session in a checkpoint
content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID)  // Latest session
content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, index) // By index
content, err := store.ReadSessionContentByID(ctx, checkpointID, sessionID)  // By ID
```

**Transcript scoping** (lines 671-673):
```go
// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion only
scopedTranscript := scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint(content.Transcript, 
                                                  content.Metadata.GetTranscriptStart())
```

**Prompt extraction** (lines 677-694):
```go
// Extract user prompts from JSONL transcript
condensed, err := summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptBytes)
var prompts []string
for _, entry := range condensed {
    if entry.Type == summarize.EntryTypeUser && entry.Content != "" {
        prompts = append(prompts, entry.Content)
    }
}
```

**Author lookup** (line 346):
```go
author, _ := store.GetCheckpointAuthor(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
```

**Associated commits search** (lines 598-666):
```go
// Find git commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailer
associatedCommits, _ := getAssociatedCommits(repo, fullCheckpointID, searchAll)

// Uses two search strategies:
// 1. Full DAG walk (searchAll=true) - finds commits on merged feature branches
// 2. First-parent walk (searchAll=false) - avoids walking into main's full history
```

---

### 6. **Error Handling & User Messages**

The explain command follows the project's error handling pattern:

**Silent errors** (when custom message already printed):
```go
cmd.SilenceUsage = true  // Don't show usage for prerequisite errors
fmt.Fprintln(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "User-friendly message")
return NewSilentError(errors.New("internal error"))
```

**Normal errors** (let main.go print):
```go
return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointIDPrefix)
```

**Graceful degradation** (best-effort operations):
```go
// Author and associated commits are optional
author, _ := store.GetCheckpointAuthor(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)  //nolint:errcheck
associatedCommits, _ := getAssociatedCommits(repo, fullCheckpointID, searchAll)  //nolint:errcheck
```

---

### 7. **Output Handling & Pager Integration**

**Flexible output** with optional pager:

```go
func outputExplainContent(w io.Writer, content string, noPager bool) {
    if noPager {
        fmt.Fprint(w, content)
    } else {
        outputWithPager(w, content)  // Uses $PAGER or 'less'
    }
}

func outputWithPager(w io.Writer, content string) {
    // Check if stdout is a terminal
    if f, ok := w.(*os.File); ok && f == os.Stdout && term.IsTerminal(int(f.Fd())) {
        // Count lines and use pager if content > terminal height
        lineCount := strings.Count(content, "\n")
        if lineCount > height-2 {
            cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, pager)
            cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(content)
            cmd.Run()
        }
    }
    // Fallback to direct output
}
```

**Key patterns:**
- Write to `cmd.OutOrStdout()` for normal output
- Write to `cmd.ErrOrStderr()` for errors/messages
- Use `io.Writer` interface for testability

---

### 8. **Key Data Flow Patterns**

**Pattern 1: Checkpoint detail view with export**

```
Flag validation (--checkpoint, --export, --showcase, --format, --output)
    ↓
Load committed checkpoint by ID prefix
    ↓
Load session content (transcript, prompts, metadata, summary)
    ↓
Apply redaction if showcase mode enabled
    ↓
Format output (JSON, Markdown, or default display)
    ↓
Write to file or stdout
```

**Pattern 2: Branch list view with session filtering**

```
Get repository & checkpoint store
    ↓
Collect committed checkpoints from current branch history
    ↓
Collect temporary checkpoints from shadow branches
    ↓
Group checkpoints by ID
    ↓
Apply session filter if specified
    ↓
Format as human-readable list
    ↓
Output with optional pager
```

**Pattern 3: Summary generation**

```
Load checkpoint content
    ↓
Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion
    ↓
Call summarize.GenerateFromTranscript() with files
    ↓
Persist summary via store.UpdateSummary()
    ↓
Reload content to display updated summary
```

---

### 9. **Helper Functions for Reuse**

**Most useful for insights command:**

| Function | Location | Purpose |
|----------|----------|---------|
| `getBranchCheckpoints()` | Line 1008 | Get all checkpoints on current branch (both committed & temporary) |
| `getReachableTemporaryCheckpoints()` | Line 1136 | Filter temporary checkpoints to those reachable from HEAD |
| `isShadowBranchReachable()` | Line 1173 | Check if shadow branch base commit is in HEAD's history |
| `convertTemporaryCheckpoint()` | Line 1194 | Convert temporary checkpoint to RewindPoint |
| `getAssociatedCommits()` | Line 598 | Find git commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailer |
| `computeReachableFromMain()` | Line 932 | Build set of commits on main's first-parent chain |
| `walkFirstParentCommits()` | Line 972 | Efficient history walk (no full DAG) |
| `hasCodeChanges()` | Line 1667 | Filter out metadata-only checkpoints |
| `extractPromptsFromTranscript()` | Line 677 | Parse user prompts from transcript |
| `scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint()` | Line 671 | Slice transcript to checkpoint's portion |
| `countLines()` | Line 1646 | Count lines in JSONL content |

---

### 10. **Settings & Redaction Integration**

**Loading showcase settings** (lines 408-418):

```go
cfg, err := settings.Load()
showcaseConfig := cfg.GetShowcaseConfig()
if showcaseConfig == nil {
    showcaseConfig = &redact.ShowcaseConfig{}
    *showcaseConfig = redact.DefaultShowcaseConfig()
}
```

**Layered redaction approach** (lines 420-439):

```go
// Layer 1: Entropy-based (existing)
transcriptBytes, err = redact.JSONLBytes(transcriptBytes)

// Layer 2: Pattern-based + structural
transcriptBytes, err = redact.ShowcaseJSONL(transcriptBytes, *showcaseConfig)

// Apply to text fields
prompts = redact.Showcase(prompts, *showcaseConfig)
contextMd = redact.Showcase(contextMd, *showcaseConfig)
filesTouched = redact.ShowcaseStringArray(filesTouched, *showcaseConfig)
```

---

### Summary of Reusable Patterns

For building the **insights command**, you can directly reuse:

1. **Flag structure** - Use similar validation pattern with early returns
2. **Data loading** - Leverage `checkpoint.GitStore` with `ReadCommitted()` and `ReadLatestSessionContent()`
3. **Formatting** - Create separate formatter functions (JSON, Markdown, display) following the pattern
4. **Helpers** - Use `getBranchCheckpoints()`, `extractPromptsFromTranscript()`, `getAssociatedCommits()`
5. **Strategy integration** - Keep strategy-agnostic, use helper functions from `strategy` and `summarize` packages
6. **Error handling** - Follow silent error pattern with custom user messages
7. **Output** - Use `io.Writer` interface with optional pager support
8. **Settings** - Load via `settings.Load()`, apply redaction conditionally

The explain command is well-architected for extensibility—you can build on these same patterns for insights without duplicating code.

- `checkpoint.GitStore` - Central store interface (lines 257, 1009)
- `checkpoint.CheckpointSummary` - Root metadata with aggregated stats
- `checkpoint.SessionContent` - Full session data (transcript, prompts, metadata)
- `checkpoint.CommittedMetadata` - Per-session metadata with token usage, summary, etc.
- `id.CheckpointID` - Type-safe checkpoint identifier (12-hex-char)

**Fallback to temporary checkpoints** (lines 276-289):
When committed checkpoint not found, try temporary checkpoints with `explainTemporaryCheckpoint()` which:
- Lists all shadow branches
- Filters by commit hash prefix
- Handles ambiguous prefixes
- Falls back gracefully

---

### 3. **Formatter Organization**

Formatters are organized by **output destination** and **format type**:

**In `explain_formatters.go`:**

| Function | Purpose | Output |
|----------|---------|--------|
| `formatExportJSON()` | Structured export | JSON object with checkpoint data |
| `formatExportMarkdown()` | Human-friendly export | Markdown document with sections |

**Shared formatting utilities** (from `explain.go`):

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `formatCheckpointOutput()` | Main display formatter (verbose/full/short modes) |
| `formatTranscriptBytes()` | Parse & format JSONL transcript |
| `formatSummaryDetails()` | AI summary sections (learnings, friction, open items) |
| `formatBranchCheckpoints()` | List view with checkpoint grouping |
| `formatCheckpointGroup()` | Single checkpoint group formatting |

**Key formatter characteristics:**

1. **Modular design** - Each formatter handles one output format
2. **Reuses transcript parsing** - `formatTranscriptBytes()` calls `summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes()` 
3. **Handles missing data gracefully** - Fallback strings when transcript unavailable
4. **Privacy-aware** - Export formatters apply redaction before output (lines 408-439)

**Code reuse example** (lines 84-87 of explain_formatters.go):
```go
sb.WriteString("## Transcript\n\n")
formattedTranscript := formatTranscriptBytes(transcript, "")  // Shared function!
sb.WriteString(formattedTranscript)
```

---

### 4. **Strategy Package Integration**

The explain command is **strategy-agnostic** but uses strategy helpers:

**Key integration points:**

1. **Checkpoint discovery** (lines 1008-1130 in `getBranchCheckpoints()`):
   ```go
   // Strategy-agnostic: queries both committed & temporary
   committedInfos, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   tempPoints := getReachableTemporaryCheckpoints(repo, store, head.Hash(), isOnDefault, limit)
   ```

2. **Session info** from `strategy.RewindPoint`:
   ```go
   type RewindPoint struct {
       ID               string                    // Commit hash or branch name
       Message          string                    // Human-readable description
       Date             time.Time
       IsLogsOnly       bool                      // Committed vs temporary
       CheckpointID     id.CheckpointID           // Stable 12-hex ID
       SessionID        string
       SessionPrompt    string                    // First line of prompt
       IsTaskCheckpoint bool
       ToolUseID        string
       Agent            agent.AgentType
   }
   ```

3. **Helper functions** used:
   ```go
   strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(tree, metadataDir)     // Line 544
   strategy.TruncateDescription(text, maxLen)               // Line 559
   strategy.IsOnDefaultBranch(repo)                         // Line 935
   strategy.GetDefaultBranchName(repo)                      // Line 942
   strategy.GetMainBranchHash(repo)                         // Line 952
   strategy.GetCurrentBranchName(repo)                      // Line 1236
   ```

4. **Transcript utilities** from `summarize` package:
   ```go
   summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptBytes)   // Line 682
   summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(ctx, scopedTranscript, files) // Line 381
   ```

---

### 5. **Session & Checkpoint Access Helpers**

**Session content retrieval** (not strategy-specific):

```go
// Load any session in a checkpoint
content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID)  // Latest session
content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, index) // By index
content, err := store.ReadSessionContentByID(ctx, checkpointID, sessionID)  // By ID
```

**Transcript scoping** (lines 671-673):
```go
// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion only
scopedTranscript := scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint(content.Transcript, 
                                                  content.Metadata.GetTranscriptStart())
```

**Prompt extraction** (lines 677-694):
```go
// Extract user prompts from JSONL transcript
condensed, err := summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptBytes)
var prompts []string
for _, entry := range condensed {
    if entry.Type == summarize.EntryTypeUser && entry.Content != "" {
        prompts = append(prompts, entry.Content)
    }
}
```

**Author lookup** (line 346):
```go
author, _ := store.GetCheckpointAuthor(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
```

**Associated commits search** (lines 598-666):
```go
// Find git commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailer
associatedCommits, _ := getAssociatedCommits(repo, fullCheckpointID, searchAll)

// Uses two search strategies:
// 1. Full DAG walk (searchAll=true) - finds commits on merged feature branches
// 2. First-parent walk (searchAll=false) - avoids walking into main's full history
```

---

### 6. **Error Handling & User Messages**

The explain command follows the project's error handling pattern:

**Silent errors** (when custom message already printed):
```go
cmd.SilenceUsage = true  // Don't show usage for prerequisite errors
fmt.Fprintln(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "User-friendly message")
return NewSilentError(errors.New("internal error"))
```

**Normal errors** (let main.go print):
```go
return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointIDPrefix)
```

**Graceful degradation** (best-effort operations):
```go
// Author and associated commits are optional
author, _ := store.GetCheckpointAuthor(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)  //nolint:errcheck
associatedCommits, _ := getAssociatedCommits(repo, fullCheckpointID, searchAll)  //nolint:errcheck
```

---

### 7. **Output Handling & Pager Integration**

**Flexible output** with optional pager:

```go
func outputExplainContent(w io.Writer, content string, noPager bool) {
    if noPager {
        fmt.Fprint(w, content)
    } else {
        outputWithPager(w, content)  // Uses $PAGER or 'less'
    }
}

func outputWithPager(w io.Writer, content string) {
    // Check if stdout is a terminal
    if f, ok := w.(*os.File); ok && f == os.Stdout && term.IsTerminal(int(f.Fd())) {
        // Count lines and use pager if content > terminal height
        lineCount := strings.Count(content, "\n")
        if lineCount > height-2 {
            cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, pager)
            cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(content)
            cmd.Run()
        }
    }
    // Fallback to direct output
}
```

**Key patterns:**
- Write to `cmd.OutOrStdout()` for normal output
- Write to `cmd.ErrOrStderr()` for errors/messages
- Use `io.Writer` interface for testability

---

### 8. **Key Data Flow Patterns**

**Pattern 1: Checkpoint detail view with export**

```
Flag validation (--checkpoint, --export, --showcase, --format, --output)
    ↓
Load committed checkpoint by ID prefix
    ↓
Load session content (transcript, prompts, metadata, summary)
    ↓
Apply redaction if showcase mode enabled
    ↓
Format output (JSON, Markdown, or default display)
    ↓
Write to file or stdout
```

**Pattern 2: Branch list view with session filtering**

```
Get repository & checkpoint store
    ↓
Collect committed checkpoints from current branch history
    ↓
Collect temporary checkpoints from shadow branches
    ↓
Group checkpoints by ID
    ↓
Apply session filter if specified
    ↓
Format as human-readable list
    ↓
Output with optional pager
```

**Pattern 3: Summary generation**

```
Load checkpoint content
    ↓
Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion
    ↓
Call summarize.GenerateFromTranscript() with files
    ↓
Persist summary via store.UpdateSummary()
    ↓
Reload content to display updated summary
```

---

### 9. **Helper Functions for Reuse**

**Most useful for insights command:**

| Function | Location | Purpose |
|----------|----------|---------|
| `getBranchCheckpoints()` | Line 1008 | Get all checkpoints on current branch (both committed & temporary) |
| `getReachableTemporaryCheckpoints()` | Line 1136 | Filter temporary checkpoints to those reachable from HEAD |
| `isShadowBranchReachable()` | Line 1173 | Check if shadow branch base commit is in HEAD's history |
| `convertTemporaryCheckpoint()` | Line 1194 | Convert temporary checkpoint to RewindPoint |
| `getAssociatedCommits()` | Line 598 | Find git commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailer |
| `computeReachableFromMain()` | Line 932 | Build set of commits on main's first-parent chain |
| `walkFirstParentCommits()` | Line 972 | Efficient history walk (no full DAG) |
| `hasCodeChanges()` | Line 1667 | Filter out metadata-only checkpoints |
| `extractPromptsFromTranscript()` | Line 677 | Parse user prompts from transcript |
| `scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint()` | Line 671 | Slice transcript to checkpoint's portion |
| `countLines()` | Line 1646 | Count lines in JSONL content |

---

### 10. **Settings & Redaction Integration**

**Loading showcase settings** (lines 408-418):

```go
cfg, err := settings.Load()
showcaseConfig := cfg.GetShowcaseConfig()
if showcaseConfig == nil {
    showcaseConfig = &redact.ShowcaseConfig{}
    *showcaseConfig = redact.DefaultShowcaseConfig()
}
```

**Layered redaction approach** (lines 420-439):

```go
// Layer 1: Entropy-based (existing)
transcriptBytes, err = redact.JSONLBytes(transcriptBytes)

// Layer 2: Pattern-based + structural
transcriptBytes, err = redact.ShowcaseJSONL(transcriptBytes, *showcaseConfig)

// Apply to text fields
prompts = redact.Showcase(prompts, *showcaseConfig)
contextMd = redact.Showcase(contextMd, *showcaseConfig)
filesTouched = redact.ShowcaseStringArray(filesTouched, *showcaseConfig)
```

---

### Summary of Reusable Patterns

For building the **insights command**, you can directly reuse:

1. **Flag structure** - Use similar validation pattern with early returns
2. **Data loading** - Leverage `checkpoint.GitStore` with `ReadCommitted()` and `ReadLatestSessionContent()`
3. **Formatting** - Create separate formatter functions (JSON, Markdown, display) following the pattern
4. **Helpers** - Use `getBranchCheckpoints()`, `extractPromptsFromTranscript()`, `getAssociatedCommits()`
5. **Strategy integration** - Keep strategy-agnostic, use helper functions from `strategy` and `summarize` packages
6. **Error handling** - Follow silent error pattern with custom user messages
7. **Output** - Use `io.Writer` interface with optional pager support
8. **Settings** - Load via `settings.Load()`, apply redaction conditionally

The explain command is well-architected for extensibility—you can build on these same patterns for insights without duplicating code.

# ENTIRE CLI - Session and Checkpoint Data Structures Reference

## 1. SESSION STATE (Live Sessions)
Location: `.git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json`
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/session/state.go`

### Type: session.State
Key Fields:
- SessionID string              - Unique session identifier (e.g., "2025-12-01-8f76b0e8-b8f1-4a87-9186-848bdd83d62e")
- CLIVersion string             - Version that created this session
- BaseCommit string             - Current shadow branch base (updated on migration)
- AttributionBaseCommit string  - Preserved for accurate attribution through mid-turn commits
- WorktreePath string           - Absolute path to worktree root
- WorktreeID string             - Internal git worktree ID (empty for main)
- StartedAt time.Time           - Session start time
- EndedAt *time.Time            - When explicitly closed (nil if active/not cleanly closed)
- Phase Phase                   - Lifecycle stage: "idle", "active", "active_committed", "ended"
- PendingCheckpointID string    - 12-hex-char ID for current commit cycle
- LastInteractionTime *time.Time - Updated on every hook invocation (for stale detection)
- StepCount int                 - Number of checkpoints in this session
- CheckpointTranscriptStart int - Transcript line offset where checkpoint cycle began
- UntrackedFilesAtStart []string - Files present at session start (preserved during rewind)
- FilesTouched []string         - Files modified/created/deleted during session
- LastCheckpointID id.CheckpointID - Checkpoint ID from last condensation
- AgentType agent.AgentType     - "Claude Code", "Gemini CLI", "Cursor", etc.
- TokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage  - Accumulated token usage across all checkpoints
- FirstPrompt string            - First user prompt (truncated for display)
- PromptAttributions []PromptAttribution - Line-level attribution at each prompt start
- PendingPromptAttribution *PromptAttribution - Attribution calculated at prompt start

### Type: session.PromptAttribution
- CheckpointNumber int          - Which checkpoint (1-indexed)
- UserLinesAdded int            - Lines added by user since last checkpoint
- UserLinesRemoved int          - Lines removed by user since last checkpoint
- AgentLinesAdded int           - Total agent lines added (base → last checkpoint)
- AgentLinesRemoved int         - Total agent lines removed (base → last checkpoint)
- UserAddedPerFile map[string]int - Per-file user additions for accurate tracking

### Access Functions:
```go
// Load session state by ID
state, err := stateStore.Load(ctx, sessionID)

// List all active sessions
states, err := stateStore.List(ctx)

// Save session state
err := stateStore.Save(ctx, state)

// Clear session state
err := stateStore.Clear(ctx, sessionID)
```

---

## 2. SESSION LIFECYCLE (Phase State Machine)
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/session/phase.go`

### Phase Enum
const (
    PhaseIdle            = "idle"             // Session not active
    PhaseActive          = "active"           // Agent is working
    PhaseActiveCommitted = "active_committed" // Agent working, user committed
    PhaseEnded           = "ended"            // Session explicitly closed
)

### Event Enum
- EventTurnStart         - Agent begins working on prompt
- EventTurnEnd           - Agent finishes turn
- EventGitCommit         - Git commit made
- EventSessionStart      - Session process started
- EventSessionStop       - Session process ended

### Action Enum (Emitted by Transition)
- ActionCondense                  - Condense session to permanent storage
- ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched    - Condense only if files were touched
- ActionDiscardIfNoFiles          - Discard if no files touched
- ActionMigrateShadowBranch       - Migrate shadow branch to new HEAD
- ActionWarnStaleSession          - Warn about stale session
- ActionClearEndedAt              - Clear EndedAt timestamp
- ActionUpdateLastInteraction     - Update LastInteractionTime

### State Machine Transition Function:
```go
func Transition(current Phase, event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult

// TransitionContext
type TransitionContext struct {
    HasFilesTouched    bool
    IsRebaseInProgress bool
}

// TransitionResult
type TransitionResult struct {
    NewPhase Phase
    Actions  []Action
}
```

---

## 3. CHECKPOINTS (Permanent Storage on entire/checkpoints/v1)
Location: `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch
Structure: `<checkpoint-id[:2]>/<checkpoint-id[2:]>/`
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint.go`

### Type: checkpoint.CheckpointSummary (Root metadata.json)
Root-level aggregated metadata for a checkpoint:
- CLIVersion string
- CheckpointID id.CheckpointID      - Stable 12-hex-char ID
- Strategy string                   - "manual-commit", "auto-commit"
- Branch string                     - Branch where created (empty if detached)
- CheckpointsCount int              - Number of checkpoints in session(s)
- FilesTouched []string             - Aggregate files from all sessions
- Sessions []SessionFilePaths       - Array of session file locations
- TokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage      - Aggregate token usage

### Type: checkpoint.SessionFilePaths
Per-session file location mapping:
- Metadata string                   - Path to session metadata.json
- Transcript string                 - Path to full.jsonl
- Context string                    - Path to context.md
- ContentHash string                - Path to content_hash.txt
- Prompt string                     - Path to prompt.txt

### Type: checkpoint.CommittedMetadata (Session-level metadata.json)
Stored in each session subdirectory:
- CLIVersion string
- CheckpointID id.CheckpointID
- SessionID string
- Strategy string
- CreatedAt time.Time
- Branch string
- CheckpointsCount int
- FilesTouched []string
- Agent agent.AgentType
- IsTask bool                       - Whether this is a task checkpoint
- ToolUseID string                  - Tool use ID for task checkpoints
- TranscriptIdentifierAtStart string - Last identifier when checkpoint started
- CheckpointTranscriptStart int     - Transcript line offset at checkpoint start
- TokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
- Summary *Summary                  - AI-generated summary (if available)
- InitialAttribution *InitialAttribution - Line-level attribution metrics

### Type: checkpoint.Summary (AI-Generated)
- Intent string                     - What user wanted to accomplish
- Outcome string                    - What was achieved
- Learnings LearningsSummary        - Categorized learnings
- Friction []string                 - Problems/annoyances encountered
- OpenItems []string                - Tech debt, unfinished work

### Type: checkpoint.InitialAttribution
Line-level attribution at commit time:
- CalculatedAt time.Time
- AgentLines int                    - Lines added by agent (base → shadow diff)
- HumanAdded int                    - Lines added by human (excluding modifications)
- HumanModified int                 - Lines modified by human (estimate)
- HumanRemoved int                  - Lines removed by human (excluding modifications)
- TotalCommitted int                - Net additions in commit
- AgentPercentage float64           - agent_lines / total_committed * 100

### Directory Structure:
```
entire/checkpoints/v1/
├── <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/              # Sharded by checkpoint ID
│   ├── metadata.json               # CheckpointSummary (root level)
│   ├── 0/                          # First session (0-based indexing)
│   │   ├── metadata.json           # CommittedMetadata
│   │   ├── full.jsonl              # JSONL transcript
│   │   ├── prompt.txt              # User prompts
│   │   ├── context.md              # Generated context
│   │   ├── content_hash.txt        # SHA256 of transcript
│   │   └── tasks/<tool-use-id>/    # Task checkpoints
│   │       ├── checkpoint.json     # TaskCheckpoint struct
│   │       ├── agent-<id>.jsonl    # Subagent transcript
│   │       └── incremental/        # Incremental checkpoints
│   │           └── NNN-<tool-id>.json
│   ├── 1/                          # Second session (if multi-session)
│   └── ...
```

---

## 4. JSONL TRANSCRIPT FORMAT
Location: `<checkpoint>/full.jsonl` or live transcript file
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/transcript/types.go`

### Type: transcript.Line (Each JSONL line)
- Type string                       - "user" or "assistant"
- UUID string                       - Unique identifier for this line
- Message json.RawMessage           - JSON-encoded message (parse as UserMessage or AssistantMessage)

### Type: transcript.UserMessage
- Content interface{}               - Can be string or []TextBlock

### Type: transcript.AssistantMessage
- Content []ContentBlock            - Array of content blocks

### Type: transcript.ContentBlock
- Type string                       - "text", "tool_use", etc.
- Text string                       - For text blocks
- Name string                       - Tool/function name
- Input json.RawMessage             - Tool input payload

### Type: transcript.ToolInput
- FilePath string                   - For file operations
- NotebookPath string               - For notebook tools
- Description string                - Task description
- Command string                    - Command to run
- Pattern string                    - Search/pattern
- Skill string                      - Skill name
- URL string                        - URL for web fetch
- Prompt string                     - Prompt for tools

### Example JSONL Entry:
```json
{"type":"user","uuid":"abc-123","message":{"content":"Create a test file"}}
{"type":"assistant","uuid":"def-456","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"I'll create that"},{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"test.txt"}}]}}
```

---

## 5. STRATEGY SESSION LISTING
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/session.go`

### Type: strategy.Session
- ID string                         - Session identifier
- Description string                - Human-readable summary (first prompt or from commits)
- Strategy string                   - Strategy that created this
- StartTime time.Time               - Session start time
- Checkpoints []Checkpoint          - List of checkpoints in session

### Type: strategy.Checkpoint
- CheckpointID id.CheckpointID      - Stable 12-hex-char ID
- Message string                    - Commit message or description
- Timestamp time.Time               - When created
- IsTaskCheckpoint bool             - Whether this is a task checkpoint
- ToolUseID string                  - Tool use ID for task checkpoints

### Listing Function:
```go
// Returns all sessions from entire/checkpoints/v1 + strategy-specific additional sessions
sessions, err := ListSessions()

// Get specific session by ID (with prefix matching)
session, err := GetSession(sessionID)
```

---

## 6. CHECKPOINT INFO (For Listing)
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_types.go`

### Type: CheckpointInfo
- CheckpointID id.CheckpointID
- SessionID string
- CreatedAt time.Time
- CheckpointsCount int
- FilesTouched []string
- Agent agent.AgentType
- IsTask bool
- ToolUseID string
- SessionCount int                  - Number of sessions in checkpoint
- SessionIDs []string               - All session IDs that contributed

### Listing Function:
```go

// Returns []CheckpointInfo sorted by CreatedAt (most recent first)
```

---

## 7. REWIND POINTS (For Recovery)
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/strategy.go`

### Type: RewindPoint
- ID string                         - Unique identifier (commit hash, branch name, etc.)
- Message string                    - Human-readable description
- MetadataDir string                - Path to metadata directory
- Date time.Time                    - When created
- IsTaskCheckpoint bool             - Whether this is a task checkpoint

- Agent agent.AgentType             - Agent that created this
- SessionID string                  - Session identifier
- SessionPrompt string              - First prompt that started the session
- SessionCount int                  - Number of sessions (for multi-session)
- SessionIDs []string               - All session IDs
- SessionPrompts []string           - First prompt for each session

---

## 8. TIME FILTERING PATTERNS

### Filtering Sessions/Checkpoints by Time:

Example: Get sessions from last 7 days
```go
sessions, err := ListSessions()
if err != nil { return err }

sevenDaysAgo := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -7)
var recentSessions []Session
for _, s := range sessions {
    if s.StartTime.After(sevenDaysAgo) {
        recentSessions = append(recentSessions, s)
    }
}
```

Example: Get checkpoints from last 30 days
```go
checkpoints, err := ListCheckpoints()
if err != nil { return err }

thirtyDaysAgo := time.Now().AddDate(0, -1, 0)
var recentCheckpoints []CheckpointInfo
for _, cp := range checkpoints {
    if cp.CreatedAt.After(thirtyDaysAgo) {
        recentCheckpoints = append(recentCheckpoints, cp)
    }
}
```

---

## 9. KEY INTERFACES FOR STRATEGIES

### checkpoint.Store Interface
```go
type Store interface {
    WriteTemporary(ctx, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error)
    ReadTemporary(ctx, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadTemporaryResult, error)
    ListTemporary(ctx) ([]TemporaryInfo, error)
    
    WriteCommitted(ctx, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error
    ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID) (*CheckpointSummary, error)
    ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, sessionIndex) (*SessionContent, error)
    ReadSessionContentByID(ctx, checkpointID, sessionID) (*SessionContent, error)
    ListCommitted(ctx) ([]CommittedInfo, error)
}
```

### strategy.SessionSource Interface (Optional)
```go
type SessionSource interface {
    GetAdditionalSessions() ([]*Session, error)
}
```

---

## 10. QUICK LOOKUP TABLES

### Checkpoint ID Structure
- 12 hexadecimal characters (e.g., "a3b2c4d5e6f7")
- Used as sharded directory: "a3/b2c4d5e6f7/"
- Stored in metadata.json CheckpointSummary.checkpoint_id
- Extracted from "Entire-Checkpoint: <id>" commit trailer

### Session ID Structure
- Format: "YYYY-MM-DD-UUID" (e.g., "2025-12-01-8f76b0e8-b8f1-4a87-9186-848bdd83d62e")
- Created at session start
- Stored in session.State.SessionID and metadata files

### Files in Checkpoint Directory Structure:
- metadata.json       → CheckpointSummary or CommittedMetadata
- full.jsonl          → JSONL transcript (each line: {"type","uuid","message"})
- prompt.txt          → User prompts
- context.md          → Generated context
- content_hash.txt    → SHA256 of transcript

## 2. SESSION LIFECYCLE (Phase State Machine)
Source: `cmd/entire/cli/session/phase.go`

### Phase Enum
const (
    PhaseIdle            = "idle"             // Session not active
    PhaseActive          = "active"           // Agent is working
    PhaseActiveCommitted = "active_committed" // Agent working, user committed
    PhaseEnded           = "ended"            // Session explicitly closed

- EventTurnStart         - Agent begins working on prompt
- EventTurnEnd           - Agent finishes turn
- EventGitCommit         - Git commit made
- EventSessionStart      - Session process started
- EventSessionStop       - Session process ended

- ActionCondense                  - Condense session to permanent storage

- ActionDiscardIfNoFiles          - Discard if no files touched

- ActionWarnStaleSession          - Warn about stale session
- ActionClearEndedAt              - Clear EndedAt timestamp
- ActionUpdateLastInteraction     - Update LastInteractionTime

### State Machine Transition Function:
```go
func Transition(current Phase, event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult

// TransitionContext

    HasFilesTouched    bool
    IsRebaseInProgress bool
}

// TransitionResult

    NewPhase Phase
    Actions  []Action
}
```

Structure: `<checkpoint-id[:2]>/<checkpoint-id[2:]>/`

## 8. TIME FILTERING PATTERNS

### Filtering Sessions/Checkpoints by Time:

Example: Get sessions from last 7 days
```go
sessions, err := ListSessions()
if err != nil { return err }

sevenDaysAgo := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -7)
var recentSessions []Session
for _, s := range sessions {
    if s.StartTime.After(sevenDaysAgo) {
        recentSessions = append(recentSessions, s)
    }
}
```

Example: Get checkpoints from last 30 days
```go
checkpoints, err := ListCheckpoints()
if err != nil { return err }

thirtyDaysAgo := time.Now().AddDate(0, -1, 0)
var recentCheckpoints []CheckpointInfo
for _, cp := range checkpoints {
    if cp.CreatedAt.After(thirtyDaysAgo) {
        recentCheckpoints = append(recentCheckpoints, cp)
    }
}
```

## Session and Checkpoint Data Structures Summary

Based on my comprehensive exploration of the codebase, here's a complete reference for understanding session and checkpoint data:

### **1. LIVE SESSION STATE** (`.git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json`)

**Type: `session.State`** - Key fields you need to know:

| Field | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| `SessionID` | string | Format: "2025-12-01-uuid" |
| `StartedAt` / `EndedAt` | time.Time | Track session lifecycle |
| `Phase` | string | "idle", "active", "active_committed", "ended" |
| `FilesTouched` | []string | Files modified during session |
| `StepCount` | int | Number of checkpoints created |
| `AgentType` | agent.AgentType | "Claude Code", "Gemini CLI", etc. |
| `TokenUsage` | *agent.TokenUsage | Accumulated tokens across checkpoints |
| `FirstPrompt` | string | Truncated initial user prompt (display) |
| `PromptAttributions` | []PromptAttribution | Line-level attribution at each checkpoint |

**Access pattern:**
```go
stateStore, _ := session.NewStateStore()
states, _ := stateStore.List(ctx)              // List all active sessions
state, _ := stateStore.Load(ctx, sessionID)    // Load specific session
```

---

### **2. SESSION LIFECYCLE STATE MACHINE**

**Phases:** `idle` → `active` → `active_committed` → `ended`

**Events:** TurnStart, TurnEnd, GitCommit, SessionStart, SessionStop

**Actions emitted by transitions:**
- `ActionCondense` - Save session to permanent storage
- `ActionMigrateShadowBranch` - Update shadow branch on HEAD change
- `ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched` - Only save if files were modified
- `ActionDiscardIfNoFiles` - Clean up empty sessions

---

### **3. PERMANENT CHECKPOINTS** (`entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

**Directory structure:** `<id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/` (sharded by 12-hex checkpoint ID)

**Root file: `metadata.json`** - Type: `checkpoint.CheckpointSummary`
- `CheckpointID`: Stable 12-hex-char ID linking to user commits
- `CheckpointsCount`: Total checkpoints in session(s)
- `FilesTouched`: Aggregate files from all sessions
- `Sessions`: Array of `SessionFilePaths` (one per session)
- `TokenUsage`: Aggregate token counts

**Session subdirectories: `0/`, `1/`, etc.** (0-based, multi-session support)
Each contains:
- `metadata.json` - Type: `checkpoint.CommittedMetadata` (session-specific metadata)
- `full.jsonl` - JSONL transcript (see format below)
- `prompt.txt` - User prompts
- `context.md` - Generated context
- `content_hash.txt` - SHA256 hash
- `tasks/<tool-use-id>/` - Task checkpoint data (if applicable)

---

### **4. JSONL TRANSCRIPT FORMAT**

**Each line is a `transcript.Line`:**
```json
{
  "type": "user" or "assistant",
  "uuid": "unique-identifier",
  "message": {...}  // Raw JSON, parse based on type
}
```

**For user messages (`transcript.UserMessage`):**
```json
{"type":"user","uuid":"abc-123","message":{"content":"Create a file"}}
```

**For assistant messages (`transcript.AssistantMessage`):**
- Contains `Content` array of `ContentBlock` objects
- Each block has `Type` ("text", "tool_use")
- Tool blocks have `Name` and `Input` (JSON-encoded tool arguments)

**ContentBlock fields:**
- `Type`: "text" or "tool_use"
- `Text`: Text content (for text blocks)
- `Name`: Tool name (for tool blocks)
- `Input`: Tool input payload (JSON-encoded)

---

### **5. SESSION & CHECKPOINT LISTING**

**To list all sessions:**
```go
sessions, err := strategy.ListSessions()
// Returns []strategy.Session sorted by StartTime (most recent first)
// Automatically merges entire/checkpoints/v1 + active sessions
```

**To list all checkpoints:**
```go
checkpoints, err := strategy.ListCheckpoints()
// Returns []CheckpointInfo sorted by CreatedAt (most recent first)
// CheckpointInfo includes: ID, SessionID, CreatedAt, Agent, FilesTouched
```

---

### **6. TIME-BASED FILTERING**

**To filter sessions by date range:**
```go
sessions, _ := strategy.ListSessions()
since := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -7)  // Last 7 days
for _, s := range sessions {
    if s.StartTime.After(since) {
        // Process recent session
    }
}
```

**To filter checkpoints by date range:**
```go
checkpoints, _ := strategy.ListCheckpoints()
since := time.Now().AddDate(0, -1, 0)  // Last 30 days
for _, cp := range checkpoints {
    if cp.CreatedAt.After(since) {
        // Process recent checkpoint
    }
}
```

---

### **7. KEY DATA STRUCTURES BY LAYER**

| Layer | Type | Location | Purpose |
|-------|------|----------|---------|
| **Live** | `session.State` | `.git/entire-sessions/` | Active session tracking |
| **Live** | `session.PromptAttribution` | Within State | Line-level attribution per checkpoint |
| **Permanent** | `checkpoint.CheckpointSummary` | Root metadata.json | Aggregated checkpoint metadata |
| **Permanent** | `checkpoint.CommittedMetadata` | Session metadata.json | Per-session metadata |
| **Permanent** | `checkpoint.Summary` | Within metadata | AI-generated checkpoint summary |
| **Permanent** | `checkpoint.InitialAttribution` | Within metadata | Line-level attribution at commit |
| **Transcript** | `transcript.Line` | full.jsonl | Each JSONL entry |
| **Transcript** | `transcript.ContentBlock` | Within messages | Text/tool blocks in responses |

---

### **8. CHECKPOINT ID LINKING**

- **Format:** 12 hexadecimal characters (e.g., `a3b2c4d5e6f7`)
- **Sharding:** `a3/b2c4d5e6f7/`
- **In commits:** Stored via `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer
- **Bidirectional:** Link user commit → metadata on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch

---

### **9. REWIND POINTS** (for recovery/resume)

**Type: `strategy.RewindPoint`** - Key fields:
- `ID`: Unique identifier (commit hash, branch name, etc.)
- `Message`: Human-readable description
- `Date`: When checkpoint created
- `IsLogsOnly`: Whether only transcript can be restored (no file state)
- `SessionID` / `SessionPrompt`: Identify which session
- `SessionCount` / `SessionIDs`: For multi-session checkpoints

---

### **10. MULTI-SESSION SUPPORT**

When multiple sessions are condensed to the same checkpoint:

**CheckpointSummary:**
- `Sessions` array contains multiple `SessionFilePaths` entries
- `SessionCount` = length of Sessions array
- Sessions stored in `0/`, `1/`, `2/` etc.

**CommittedMetadata (per session):**
- Each session gets its own metadata.json in numbered subdirectory
- All sessions share the same checkpoint ID

---

### **Key Functions You'll Need:**

```go
// Session state access
stateStore.Load(ctx, sessionID)           // Load specific session
stateStore.List(ctx)                      // List all sessions

// Listing sessions and checkpoints
strategy.ListSessions()                   // All sessions (merged sources)
strategy.GetSession(sessionID)            // Find by ID or prefix
strategy.ListCheckpoints()                // All checkpoints from entire/checkpoints/v1

// Reading checkpoint content
store.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)    // Get CheckpointSummary
store.ReadSessionContent(ctx, cpID, idx)  // Get session content by index
store.ReadSessionContentByID(ctx, cpID, sessionID) // Get by session ID
```

This should give you everything you need to query and filter session/checkpoint data across all time periods!

   212→// runExplain routes to the appropriate explain function based on flags.
   213→func runExplain(w, errW io.Writer, sessionID, commitRef, checkpointID string, noPager, verbose, full, rawTranscript, generate, force, searchAll bool, export, showcase bool, format, outputFile string) error {
   214→	// Count mutually exclusive flags (--commit and --checkpoint are mutually exclusive)
   215→	// --session is now a filter for the list view, not a separate mode
   216→	flagCount := 0
   217→	if commitRef != "" {
   218→		flagCount++
   219→	}
   220→	if checkpointID != "" {
   221→		flagCount++
   222→	}
   223→	// If --session is combined with --commit or --checkpoint, that's still an error
   224→	if sessionID != "" && flagCount > 0 {
   225→		return errors.New("cannot specify multiple of --session, --commit, --checkpoint")
   226→	}
   227→	if flagCount > 1 {
   228→		return errors.New("cannot specify multiple of --session, --commit, --checkpoint")
   229→	}
   230→
   231→	// Route to appropriate handler
   232→	if commitRef != "" {
   233→		return runExplainCommit(w, commitRef, noPager, verbose, full, searchAll)
   234→	}
   235→	if checkpointID != "" {
   236→		return runExplainCheckpoint(w, errW, checkpointID, noPager, verbose, full, rawTranscript, generate, force, searchAll, export, showcase, format, outputFile)
   237→	}
   238→
   239→	// Default or with session filter: show list view (optionally filtered by session)
   240→	return runExplainBranchWithFilter(w, noPager, sessionID)
   241→}

   243→// runExplainCheckpoint explains a specific checkpoint.
   244→// Supports both committed checkpoints (by checkpoint ID) and temporary checkpoints (by git SHA).
   245→// First tries to match committed checkpoints, then falls back to temporary checkpoints.
   246→// When generate is true, generates an AI summary for the checkpoint.
   247→// When force is true, regenerates even if a summary already exists.
   248→// When rawTranscript is true, outputs only the raw transcript file (JSONL format).
   249→// When searchAll is true, searches all commits without branch/depth limits (used for finding associated commits).
   250→// When export is true, exports the checkpoint in structured format (delegates to runExportCheckpoint).
   251→func runExplainCheckpoint(w, errW io.Writer, checkpointIDPrefix string, noPager, verbose, full, rawTranscript, generate, force, searchAll bool, export, showcase bool, format, outputFile string) error {
   252→	repo, err := openRepository()
   253→	if err != nil {
   254→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   255→	}
   256→
   257→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   258→
   259→	// First, try to find in committed checkpoints by checkpoint ID prefix
   260→	committed, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   261→	if err != nil {
   262→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoints: %w", err)
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	// Collect all matching checkpoint IDs to detect ambiguity
   266→	var matches []id.CheckpointID
   267→	for _, info := range committed {
   268→		if strings.HasPrefix(info.CheckpointID.String(), checkpointIDPrefix) {
   269→			matches = append(matches, info.CheckpointID)
   270→		}
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	var fullCheckpointID id.CheckpointID
   274→	switch len(matches) {
   275→	case 0:
   276→		// Not found in committed, try temporary checkpoints by git SHA
   277→		if generate {
   278→			return fmt.Errorf("cannot generate summary for temporary checkpoint %s (only committed checkpoints supported)", checkpointIDPrefix)
   279→		}
   280→		output, found := explainTemporaryCheckpoint(w, repo, store, checkpointIDPrefix, verbose, full, rawTranscript)
   281→		if found {
   282→			outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   283→			return nil
   284→		}
   285→		// If output is non-empty, it contains an error message (e.g., ambiguous prefix)
   286→		if output != "" {
   287→			return errors.New(output)
   288→		}
   289→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointIDPrefix)
   290→	case 1:
   291→		fullCheckpointID = matches[0]
   292→	default:
   293→		// Ambiguous prefix - show up to 5 examples
   294→		examples := make([]string, 0, 5)
   295→		for i := 0; i < len(matches) && i < 5; i++ {
   296→			examples = append(examples, matches[i].String())
   297→		}
   298→		return fmt.Errorf("ambiguous checkpoint prefix %q matches %d checkpoints: %s", checkpointIDPrefix, len(matches), strings.Join(examples, ", "))
   299→	}
   300→
   301→	// Load checkpoint summary
   302→	summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   303→	if err != nil {
   304→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   305→	}
   306→	if summary == nil {
   307→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", fullCheckpointID)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	// Load latest session content (needed for transcript and metadata)
   311→	content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   312→	if err != nil {
   313→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint content: %w", err)
   314→	}
   315→
   316→	// Handle export mode (must come before summary generation and raw transcript)
   317→	if export {
   318→		return runExportCheckpoint(w, errW, fullCheckpointID, content, summary, showcase, format, outputFile)
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	// Handle summary generation
   322→	if generate {
   323→		if err := generateCheckpointSummary(w, errW, store, fullCheckpointID, summary, content, force); err != nil {
   324→			return err
   325→		}
   326→		// Reload the content to get the updated summary
   327→		content, err = store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   328→		if err != nil {
   329→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reload checkpoint: %w", err)
   330→		}
   331→	}
   332→
   333→	// Handle raw transcript output
   334→	if rawTranscript {
   335→		if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   336→			return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s has no transcript", fullCheckpointID)
   337→		}
   338→		// Output raw transcript directly (no pager, no formatting)
   339→		if _, err = w.Write(content.Transcript); err != nil {
   340→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   341→		}
   342→		return nil
   343→	}
   344→
   345→	// Look up the author for this checkpoint (best-effort, ignore errors)
   346→	author, _ := store.GetCheckpointAuthor(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID) //nolint:errcheck // Author is optional
   347→
   348→	// Find associated commits (git commits with matching Entire-Checkpoint trailer)
   349→	associatedCommits, _ := getAssociatedCommits(repo, fullCheckpointID, searchAll) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort
   350→
   351→	// Format and output
   352→	output := formatCheckpointOutput(summary, content, fullCheckpointID, associatedCommits, author, verbose, full)
   353→	outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   354→	return nil
   355→}

   357→// generateCheckpointSummary generates an AI summary for a checkpoint and persists it.
   358→// The summary is generated from the scoped transcript (only this checkpoint's portion),
   359→// not the entire session transcript.
   360→func generateCheckpointSummary(w, _ io.Writer, store *checkpoint.GitStore, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, cpSummary *checkpoint.CheckpointSummary, content *checkpoint.SessionContent, force bool) error {
   361→	// Check if summary already exists
   362→	if content.Metadata.Summary != nil && !force {
   363→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s already has a summary (use --force to regenerate)", checkpointID)
   364→	}
   365→
   366→	// Check if transcript exists
   367→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   368→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s has no transcript to summarize", checkpointID)
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	// Scope the transcript to only this checkpoint's portion
   372→	scopedTranscript := scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint(content.Transcript, content.Metadata.GetTranscriptStart())
   373→	if len(scopedTranscript) == 0 {
   374→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s has no transcript content for this checkpoint (scoped)", checkpointID)
   375→	}
   376→
   377→	// Generate summary using shared helper
   378→	ctx := context.Background()
   379→	logging.Info(ctx, "generating checkpoint summary")
   380→
   381→	summary, err := summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(ctx, scopedTranscript, cpSummary.FilesTouched, nil)
   382→	if err != nil {
   383→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate summary: %w", err)
   384→	}
   385→
   386→	// Persist the summary
   387→	if err := store.UpdateSummary(ctx, checkpointID, summary); err != nil {
   388→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save summary: %w", err)
   389→	}
   390→
   391→	fmt.Fprintln(w, "✓ Summary generated and saved")
   392→	return nil
   393→}

   395→// runExportCheckpoint exports a checkpoint in structured format (JSON or Markdown).
   396→// Applies showcase redaction if requested.
   397→func runExportCheckpoint(w, _ io.Writer, checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   398→	content *checkpoint.SessionContent, summary *checkpoint.CheckpointSummary,
   399→	showcase bool, format, outputFile string) error {
   400→
   401→	// Prepare transcript for export
   402→	transcriptBytes := content.Transcript
   403→	prompts := content.Prompts
   404→	contextMd := string(content.Context)
   405→	filesTouched := content.Metadata.FilesTouched
   406→
   407→	// Apply redaction if showcase mode
   408→	if showcase {
   409→		cfg, err := settings.Load()
   410→		if err != nil {
   411→			return fmt.Errorf("loading settings: %w", err)
   412→		}
   413→
   414→		showcaseConfig := cfg.GetShowcaseConfig()
   415→		if showcaseConfig == nil {
   416→			showcaseConfig = &redact.ShowcaseConfig{}
   417→			*showcaseConfig = redact.DefaultShowcaseConfig()
   418→		}
   419→
   420→		// Layer 1: Existing entropy-based redaction
   421→		transcriptBytes, err = redact.JSONLBytes(transcriptBytes)
   422→		if err != nil {
   423→			return fmt.Errorf("entropy redaction failed: %w", err)
   424→		}
   425→
   426→		// Layer 2: Showcase redaction (patterns, blocklist, structural)
   427→		transcriptBytes, err = redact.ShowcaseJSONL(transcriptBytes, *showcaseConfig)
   428→		if err != nil {
   429→			return fmt.Errorf("showcase redaction failed: %w", err)
   430→		}
   431→
   432→		prompts = redact.Showcase(prompts, *showcaseConfig)
   433→		contextMd = redact.Showcase(contextMd, *showcaseConfig)
   434→
   435→		filesTouched = make([]string, len(content.Metadata.FilesTouched))
   436→		for i, path := range content.Metadata.FilesTouched {
   437→			filesTouched[i] = redact.Showcase(path, *showcaseConfig)
   438→		}
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Format output
   442→	var output []byte
   443→	var err error
   444→
   445→	switch format {
   446→	case "json":
   447→		output, err = formatExportJSON(checkpointID, content, summary,
   448→			transcriptBytes, prompts, contextMd, filesTouched)
   449→	case "markdown":
   450→		output, err = formatExportMarkdown(checkpointID, content, summary,
   451→			transcriptBytes, prompts, contextMd, filesTouched)
   452→	default:
   453→		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported format: %s", format)
   454→	}
   455→
   456→	if err != nil {
   457→		return fmt.Errorf("formatting failed: %w", err)
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	// Write output
   461→	if outputFile == "" {
   462→		if _, err = w.Write(output); err != nil {
   463→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write output: %w", err)
   464→		}
   465→	} else {
   466→		//nolint:gosec // G306: export file is public output, 0o644 is appropriate
   467→		if err := os.WriteFile(outputFile, output, 0o644); err != nil {
   468→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write file: %w", err)
   469→		}
   470→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "Exported to %s\n", outputFile)
   471→	}
   472→
   473→	return nil
   474→}

   476→// explainTemporaryCheckpoint finds and formats a temporary checkpoint by shadow commit hash prefix.
   477→// Returns the formatted output and whether the checkpoint was found.
   478→// Searches ALL shadow branches, not just the one for current HEAD, to find checkpoints
   479→// created from different base commits (e.g., if HEAD advanced since session start).
   480→// The writer w is used for raw transcript output to bypass the pager.
   481→func explainTemporaryCheckpoint(w io.Writer, repo *git.Repository, store *checkpoint.GitStore, shaPrefix string, verbose, full, rawTranscript bool) (string, bool) {
   482→	// List temporary checkpoints from ALL shadow branches
   483→	// This ensures we find checkpoints even if HEAD has advanced since the session started
   484→	tempCheckpoints, err := store.ListAllTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), "", branchCheckpointsLimit)
   485→	if err != nil {
   486→		return "", false
   487→	}
   488→
   489→	// Find checkpoints matching the SHA prefix - check for ambiguity
   490→	var matches []checkpoint.TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   491→	for _, tc := range tempCheckpoints {
   492→		if strings.HasPrefix(tc.CommitHash.String(), shaPrefix) {
   493→			matches = append(matches, tc)
   494→		}
   495→	}
   496→
   497→	if len(matches) == 0 {
   498→		return "", false
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   502→		// Multiple matches - return ambiguous error (consistent with committed checkpoint behavior)
   503→		var sb strings.Builder
   504→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "ambiguous checkpoint prefix %q matches %d temporary checkpoints:\n", shaPrefix, len(matches))
   505→		for _, m := range matches {
   506→			shortID := m.CommitHash.String()[:7]
   507→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  %s  %s  session %s\n",
   508→				shortID,
   509→				m.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
   510→				m.SessionID)
   511→		}
   512→		// Return as "not found" with error message - caller will use this as error
   513→		return sb.String(), false
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	tc := matches[0]
   517→
   518→	// Handle raw transcript output
   519→	if rawTranscript {
   520→		transcriptBytes, transcriptErr := store.GetTranscriptFromCommit(tc.CommitHash, tc.MetadataDir, agent.AgentTypeUnknown)
   521→		if transcriptErr != nil || len(transcriptBytes) == 0 {
   522→			// Return specific error message (consistent with committed checkpoints)
   523→			return fmt.Sprintf("checkpoint %s has no transcript", tc.CommitHash.String()[:7]), false
   524→		}
   525→		// Write directly to writer (no pager, no formatting) - matches committed checkpoint behavior
   526→		if _, writeErr := fmt.Fprint(w, string(transcriptBytes)); writeErr != nil {
   527→			return fmt.Sprintf("failed to write transcript: %v", writeErr), false
   528→		}
   529→		return "", true
   530→	}
   531→
   532→	// Found exactly one match - read metadata from shadow branch commit tree
   533→	shadowCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(tc.CommitHash)
   534→	if commitErr != nil {
   535→		return "", false
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	shadowTree, treeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   539→	if treeErr != nil {
   540→		return "", false
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Read prompts from shadow branch
   544→	sessionPrompt := strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(shadowTree, tc.MetadataDir)
   545→
   546→	// Build output similar to formatCheckpointOutput but for temporary
   547→	var sb strings.Builder
   548→	shortID := tc.CommitHash.String()[:7]
   549→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoint: %s [temporary]\n", shortID)
   550→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", tc.SessionID)
   551→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Created: %s\n", tc.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   552→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   553→
   554→	// Intent from prompt
   555→	intent := "(not available)"
   556→	if sessionPrompt != "" {
   557→		lines := strings.Split(sessionPrompt, "\n")
   558→		if len(lines) > 0 && lines[0] != "" {
   559→			intent = strategy.TruncateDescription(lines[0], maxIntentDisplayLength)
   560→		}
   561→	}
   562→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", intent)
   563→	sb.WriteString("Outcome: (not generated)\n")
   564→
   565→	// Transcript section: full shows entire session, verbose shows checkpoint scope
   566→	// For temporary checkpoints, load transcript and compute scope from parent commit
   567→	var fullTranscript []byte
   568→	var scopedTranscript []byte
   569→	if full || verbose {
   570→		fullTranscript, _ = store.GetTranscriptFromCommit(tc.CommitHash, tc.MetadataDir, agent.AgentTypeUnknown) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort
   571→
   572→		if verbose && len(fullTranscript) > 0 {
   573→			// Compute scoped transcript by finding where parent's transcript ended
   574→			// Each shadow branch commit has the full transcript up to that point,
   575→			// so we diff against parent to get just this checkpoint's activity
   576→			scopedTranscript = fullTranscript // Default to full if no parent
   577→			if shadowCommit.NumParents() > 0 {
   578→				if parent, parentErr := shadowCommit.Parent(0); parentErr == nil {
   579→					parentTranscript, _ := store.GetTranscriptFromCommit(parent.Hash, tc.MetadataDir, agent.AgentTypeUnknown) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort
   580→					if len(parentTranscript) > 0 {
   581→						// Count lines in parent transcript to know where to slice from
   582→						parentLineCount := countLines(parentTranscript)
   583→						scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(fullTranscript, parentLineCount)
   584→					}
   585→				}
   586→			}
   587→		}
   588→	}
   589→	appendTranscriptSection(&sb, verbose, full, fullTranscript, scopedTranscript, sessionPrompt)
   590→
   591→	return sb.String(), true
   592→}
